name: AFAS Customer Data Fetcher
description: Retrieve customer-related data including attachments from AFAS

afasBaseUrl.label: AFAS Base URL
afasBaseUrl.description: The base URL of the AFAS instance (e.g., https://example.afas.online)

clientId.label: AFAS Client ID
clientId.description: The client ID for AFAS API authentication

clientSecret.label: AFAS Client Secret
clientSecret.description: The client secret for AFAS API authentication

customerId.label: Customer ID
customerId.description: The ID of the customer to fetch data for

subjectId.label: Subject ID
subjectId.description: The ID of the subject to fetch attachments for

includeAttachments.label: Include Attachments
includeAttachments.description: Whether to include attachments in the response

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of records to return

offset.label: Offset
offset.description: Number of records to skip for pagination

success.label: Success
success.description: Indicates whether the request was successful

error.label: Error
error.description: Error message if the request failed

attachments.label: Attachments
attachments.description: List of attachment objects associated with the customer or subject
